title: Magnolia Sunset Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
meta_description: Located between Watersound and Seacrest, Magnolia Sunset is a beautifully decorated 3 bedroom ranch in a private community with direct access to the beach and a shared community pool
description_expanded: **SNOWBIRD PROMOTION- Save 50% PER NIGHT January and February for monthly stays!** HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - ACCESS TO THE PUBLIC WIDE BEACH (OR PRIVATE FOR MAIN TOWNS) WITH NO RESTRICTIONS - 2 adult sized beach cruisers included - Charcoal grill - Fully stocked kitchen - Golf cart friendly neighborhood - Community pool - Short 5-minute walk to the beach, community pool, shopping, and dining - Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. OPTIONAL ADD-ONS: -Vacation Cancellation Protection- Allows cancellation for any reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies refunded ($125 fee applies at booking) -Pet Fee $150 Stay in the heart of 30A paradise! Located in the private neighborhood of Magnolia Cottages By The Sea near Seacrest, “Magnolia Sunset” is a charming 3 bedroom/3 bath home with all the amenities beach living has to offer. 5-minute walk to the private beach access & neighborhood pool, just 1 mile to The Hub & Alys and 2 miles to Rosemary! Magnolia Sunset sleeps 8 guests with a generous open floorplan. Upon entering the cottage, you will be welcomed into a well-stocked, updated and open kitchen. The kitchen bar seats 4 while the dining area, just off of the kitchen seats 8 comfortably. The kitchen opens up to the great room that features beautiful, planked ceilings, a large 50-inch television with enough seating for the whole family to enjoy. Start your day with your morning coffee or happy hour on the oversized screened in porch located right off of the living and dining room. The porch overlooks peaceful, private wooded views perfect for relaxing. ACCOMMODATIONS: (sleeps 8) Bedroom 1: King master suite with a TV and en-suite bathroom with shower Bedroom 2: Queen suite, TV and private bathroom with a tub/shower combo Bedroom 3: 2 Queen beds (sleeps 4) Hall bathroom right outside of the bedroom (shower only) IMPORTANT DETAILS: ** This property allows one, small non-shedding dog for an additional $150 pet fee. ** Neighborhood pool is heated in the colder months Must be 25 + to rent FREE WIFI Certificate #027164 TDT #33599

Health And Safety: High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant
Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF
